ops.title: Phase 2 ranker: what pays, what was measured and deleted (2026-07-27)
ops.body:
Measured on the 42-question monorepo subset (97 entities, k=10, 5 seeds) plus 10 held-out questions across 5 other repos. Baseline gated (bm25 + supersede gate) = ndcg 0.818 / recall 0.910 / mrr 0.805. Shipped ranker (internal/kg/rank, lex+enrich+graph) = 0.877 / 0.981 / 0.888.

WHAT PAYS
1. Anchor enrichment of the BM25 text (path stem x2 + last 3 dirs + branch + full commit sha, ported from cc-context semsearch/rank.EnrichForBM25): 0.818 -> 0.843. Stem x1 vs x2 measured identical to 3dp; kept the faithful port.
2. Background-normalized personalized PageRank at RRF weight 0.5: 0.843 -> 0.877.

WHAT WAS MEASURED AND DELETED
- cc-context's 3:1 dense:lex RRF weights are WRONG for a graph lane. Sweep: w=0.25 -> 0.863, 0.5 -> 0.877, 1.0 -> 0.859, 2.0 -> 0.843, 3.0 -> 0.837. A graph lane is a supporting lane, not a co-equal one.
- Raw PPR mass loses to mass/background everywhere (6/6 grid cells, e.g. 0.735 vs 0.799 at w=3). Two hops over 4859 edges reach nearly every record, so raw mass just re-ranks hubs.
- The plan's 'recency x importance x relevance, alpha=1' composite is catastrophic and monotonically harmful from exponent 0 up: recency^1 -> 0.408, importance^1 -> 0.073 (worse than full-context). No useful exponent exists. Deleted; the ranker composes fused relevance x staleness weight only. Graph importance survives only as the lift denominator.
- HippoRAG-style lexical seeding of the walk (top-5 lexical hits as extra seeds) is a wash: 5 wins / 5 losses, sign-test p=1.0. Deleted. The graph lane seeds only on addresses the query names and on session state.
- MMR at lambda 0.7 is neutral: ndcg 0.877 -> 0.873, mrr 0.888 -> 0.893. Kept for the budget-fill path, not for the metric.

BUG FOUND BY A FIXTURE TEST
Truncated PPR must ACCUMULATE the damped walk over every path length up to H, (1-d)*sum_h d^h W^h p — not return the distribution after exactly H steps. The naive iteration x<-(1-d)p+dWx read at t=H leaves ~72 percent of the mass at exactly H hops, ranking a record two hops out above the one the seed points straight at. Fixing it moved factual back to 1.000 and cross_branch to 0.757.

DETERMINISM
Go map iteration order over float accumulations made the ranking wobble between runs (0.845 vs 0.848 on identical input). Every seed-mass sum now runs in sorted index order.
